versions.content: Computation methods are used for the conversion of inter- nal values into their physical representation and vice versa CompuMethod s are used for the conversion of internal values into their physical representation and vice versa. The direction of the conversion depends on the origin of the value to be con- verted: • If the value is provided by the ECU, then the conversion direction is from internal to physical. • If a physical value is provided by the tester, it is converted to internal values before being sent to the ECU

Computation methods are used for the conversion of in- ternal values into their physical representation and vice versa CompuMethod s are used for the conversion of internal values into their physical representation and vice versa. The direction of the conversion depends on the origin of the value to be converted: • If the value is provided by the ECU, then the conversion direction is from internal to physical . • If a physical value is provided by the tester, it is converted to an internal value before being sent to the ECU.
